config.record_grain: One current AFS licence register entry per licensee snapshot row.

fields.evidence: Help file p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee ABN or ACN; ABN is shown when provided. Sample row 2: 85007186003.
Help file p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee ABN or ACN; ACN is shown only if no ABN is provided. Validation distinguishes types.
Help file p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is locality from the current principal business address. Sample row 2: SOUTHBANK.
Help file p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is state from the current principal business address. Sample row 2: VIC.
Help file p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is postcode from the current principal business address. Sample row 2: 3006.
Help file p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is country of the principal business address; outside Australia is International. Sample row 2: Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Identifies the register to which the record belongs (help file p.8); no corresponding assignment-subset field.
Unique AFS licence number (help file p.8), not a legal-entity identifier in the supplied ontology; preserve as source-record provenance outside canonical fields.

Retained verbatim through subject_label_field only. Help file p.8 calls it the register entry name and specifies that it may be a person's given and last names or an organisation name; it is not safely a registered legal name.
Start date of the Australian Financial Services licensee (help file p.8), which is a licence date and must not map to entity.date_registered.
Serialized previous pre-FSR register type and licence number(s) (help file p.9), with no corresponding field in the assignment subset.
Serialized current licence authorisations/conditions (help file p.11), with no corresponding field in the assignment subset.

limitations: Documentation states this is a point-in-time snapshot of publicly available information for current AFS licensees (help file p.3); current inclusion supports neither legal-entity status nor company registration status.
The supplied publication timestamp is used only as the publication proxy because no row-level snapshot/effective timestamp is available.

AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is a mixed ABN/ACN field. Both mappings intentionally validate the raw value; no ACN is inferred from an ABN suffix, and invalid or opposite-type values produce no value for that canonical field.
The register entry can be an individual or organisation (help file p.8). No legal name, entity type, trading name, or entity status is asserted.

Address components are only the current principal business address; documentation says blanks can indicate an address that could not be validated (help file pp.9-10). No full address can be constructed from the supplied columns.
No record filter is encoded: documentation already defines this dataset as current licensees (help file p.3), while the supplied CSV has no status column to test.
Source authority and all field confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
